monkey_patch_transformers: apply monkey patches to the transformers library for compatibility with auto_round quantization
parse_layer_config_arg: parse a CLI layer configuration string into a normalized Python dictionary
compress_layer_names: compress numbered layer names into a compact range notation like layer.[0-2]
infer_bits_by_data_type: infer the quantization bit width from a data type string like int4 or fp8
to_standard_regex: convert a user-specified layer name pattern into a standardized regex for matching
